boundary: If the wrong record were not published immediately as purchasable units with checkout reservation, the harm would be only an inventory data error (Information Quality); because customers can buy units that do not exist, it is an asset loss.
factor: inflated stock count on a live, immediately published offer enabling overselling
note: Assessor correctly identified the wrong variant but framed the harm as corrupted data and asserted no second harm, never stating the reserve-on-checkout behaviour that turns 15 counted units into 30 sellable ones, which gives Financial / Assets.
